home_hero_tagline: Authentic Pakistani and Indian cuisine in the heart of Debrecen.
home_popular_subtitle: A few favorites our guests keep coming back for.
home_about_body: Discover the rich flavors of Pakistani and Indian cuisine in a warm and friendly atmosphere. Our dishes are prepared using traditional recipes, fresh ingredients, and authentic spices to give every guest a truly memorable dining experience.
home_visit_body: Open every day from 11:00 to 23:00 at 50 Darabos Street, Debrecen.
menu_intro: From soups and tandoor classics to biryani, desserts, and drinks - the full Masala Garden menu.
menu_lunch_subtitle: Monday to Friday, 11:30-14:00. Served with rice or naan.
menu_allergens_note: Our dishes may contain allergens. If you have any food allergies or intolerances, please inform our staff before ordering. Please note that cross-contamination cannot be completely excluded.
about_body_1: Discover the rich flavors of Pakistani and Indian cuisine in a warm and friendly atmosphere! Our dishes are prepared using traditional recipes, fresh ingredients, and authentic spices to provide every guest with a truly memorable dining experience.
about_body_2: Our comfortable 40-seat restaurant is the perfect place for a family lunch, a romantic dinner, or a gathering with friends. During the warmer months, guests can enjoy our cozy outdoor terrace, while free parking makes your visit even more convenient.
about_body_3: Our restaurant is also an ideal venue for weddings, birthday celebrations, corporate events, and other family or private occasions. We are happy to help make your special event truly unforgettable.
about_closing: We warmly welcome you to experience the authentic flavors of Pakistan and India, where hospitality and quality come together.
contact_reservation_body: We don't take online bookings - give us a call and we'll set a table for you.
